title: Zenith Workout Steps Schema
description: Validates the structure of the steps array inside planned_workouts, representing interval blocks.

name.description: The name or description of this block (e.g. 'Warm Up', 'Interval 1').

duration.description: Duration of the block in seconds.

powerPct.description: Power targets as a percentage of FTP (e.g. 0.85 for 85%).

zone.description: Target power zone (1 = Recovery, 2 = Endurance, 3 = Tempo, 4 = Threshold, 5 = VO2Max, 6 = Anaerobic, 7 = Neuromuscular).

color.description: Color code representing the zone color in hex format.
